description: 15-turn regression script. Shared by evaluation/run_demo.py (core) and the Compare tab's 'Run demo script' button (UI). Per turn: expect = keywords that must ALL appear in the answer (case-insensitive); forbid = phrases that must NOT appear. Final graph checks use keyword lists matched case-insensitively against fact['text']: final_active = some ACTIVE fact contains all keywords; final_retired = some RETIRED fact contains all keywords AND no ACTIVE fact does; final_absent = no ACTIVE fact contains all keywords.
